chapter: Neko Is a Cat: Shrine Canteen
act_title: Neko Is a Cat: Shrine Canteen

quests.title: Neko Is a Cat: Shrine Canteen

dialogue.t: This is... quite incredible...
When we began, that stone did not look a thing like me. But with each passing glance, it becomes more and more so.
You humans really are incredible.
It is very noisy, yes, but I am the provisional head priestess. Such trivial matters are not worth complaining about.
Bring these fish to that tall human.
They are good things, and may be considered his... "celery."
Meow, I did get Konbumaru to lead those children to try to catch some finches, but it did not turn out very well.
For them, catching fish is still simpler.
Well, this certainly looks the part now...
Haha, it's you. Do you think it looks a bit more like the Lady Priestess now?

dialogue.sit: It's a lot larger, that's for sure.

dialogue.t: Right? Ah, I spent a few days burning the midnight oil on this, too...
Ah, I'm pretty hungry, I think... Time to go look for something to eat again...
Hmm, well, the Lady Priestess has my thanks, but uh... I think I'll look for food on my own...
I've eaten fish for several straight days now. I don't think I could eat any more...
I've been heading out to forage for food. When I'm lucky, I can grab a finch or a pigeon...
*sigh* But what I'd like to have is some meat, you know? Some firm, juicy meat...
So, uh, Traveler...
If you don't mind, could you get me three servings of Raw Meat?
I'm no good at hunting, so I haven't been able to get any meat these past few days... So please, give me a hand!

dialogue.sit: Did you think of going back to Narukami Island to have a meal?

dialogue.t: Please help me out. Just three servings will do!
How did it go? Were you able to get the Raw Meat?
Ooh... the marbling... Thank you both so much!
I'll whip up a few good dishes in just a moment. With any luck, I might even finish my carving faster after eating, haha!

dialogue.sit: What do the two have in common, again?

dialogue.t: Eating some good meat gives you the strength to keep going! It just wasn't the same with those fish. I couldn't help but feel like my hands were too weak for the work...
Honestly, I was starting to get worried that I might take longer than expected to finish the whole statue. Well, that's not a problem now, thanks to you!
I mean, I am being employed by a... cat, sure, but one should always avoid asking for extensions.
Whatever the case, I'll get this one done as soon as I can... Come to think of it, the Lady Priestess said that once the statue is completed, something good will happen.
I'm not sure what that means exactly, but well... I'm quite looking forward to it, actually.
Come back in a while and have a look at the final product.

quests.description: Neko, “Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine,” seems to have business with you…
